notes: 73 CV publications, including the separately stated 2022 second edition; 33 match distinct graph work IDs and 40 have no match. The in-progress On Every Screen manuscript, presentations, grants, teaching and service are excluded. Rachel Manes withdrew in 2023; Vera Zoricic is current; Eric Vero was co-supervised with Jay Dolmage. Committee and examiner roles are excluded from supervision. Repeated graph rows: w-529693 twice, w-506830 twice, w-394219 three times. CV/graph years differ for Exploring Big Historical Data (2016/2015), Mining the Internet Graveyard (2013/2012) and Studying the Web in the Shadow of Uncle Sam (2018/2019). Illusionary Order has a different subtitle but is a strong match; Welcome to the Web is truncated and misclassified as an article. w-683732 concatenates multilingual titles including the CV Spanish title. Several books and journal articles are typed other; conference papers are typed article. The Great WARC Adventure has SLAAPs in the CV and SLAPPs in the graph. Extra-work attributions are inferences from these files only; Preface remains especially uncertain.
